text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High GPU queue depth in region east2 for model v2-large. 90th p99 latency spiking, error rate rising. Alert: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/alerts/ALRT-1729

Oncall Anna: Acked. I'm on it. Paging SRE and infra.

Ben Ops: I'm up — seeing autoscaler failed to provision new GPUs in east2, provisioning calls timed out (cloud provider quota error). Logs show multiple AZ provisioning failures.

Carla SRE: Confirmed queue growth on east2 -> backlog 18k, per-pool queue > 10s. Traffic steering tried to spillover to eu-west1 but we see increased cold-starts there, causing eu-west1 queue to bump too. Looks like routing weight for spillover still points to v2-large-primary rather than v2-small-fallback.

Oncall Anna: Customers? CE support any reports from top accounts? @CE Support?

CE Support: We have ~6 enterprise customers reporting elevated 5xx and timeouts. One (acme-inc) is seeing ~30% of requests returning 503; support ticket opened: #CS-8245.

Dave Reliability: Root cause hypothesis — autoscaler in east2 hit quota/soft-limit, cloud returns 429/insufficient capacity; autoscaler retries and times out; routing kept sending to east2 until queue threshold triggered spillover, but spillover target in eu-west1 is using same model flavor (v2-large) which is also cold and takes long to spin up, amplifying latency. Also a recent routing rule change (rollout yesterday) modified fallback weight table erroneously.

Carla SRE: Mitigation plan (short term): 1) Pause normal routing to east2 for non-critical routes. 2) Redirect spillover to quantized variant v2-large-q4_0 in eu-west1 and ap-south1 (faster cold starts). 3) Temporarily throttle low-priority jobs (batch/analytics) across regions. 4) Request infra to request quota bump and start manual provisioning in east2.

Oncall Anna: I'll execute (1) and (2) now. Notifying infra.

Eng Runtime: Before changing weights, note that v2-large-q4_0 has slightly lower quality; we should limit to non-paying and non-SLA traffic first.

Oncall Anna: Understood. Applying weighted steer rules to route only non-SLA traffic and background requests to q4_0. Command:```
# set temporary routing weights for spillover
rwctl route update --from east2 --spillover-targets eu-west1:50,ap-south1:50 --model-filter=non-sla
```

Ben Ops: Running the command. Response: "ok: routing update pushed (id=rt-7f3b)".

metrics-bot: region=east2 queue_depth=18234 p95_latency=4123ms errors=12.7%

Carla SRE: Now throttling low-priority routes. Command:```
rwctl policy set --name low-priority-throttle --rate 5rps --target=background
```

Ben Ops: Throttle applied. Background traffic dropped ~60% in ~30s.

Oncall Anna: Notifying customers via status page update: "Degraded performance in region east2; spillover in effect to eu-west1 and ap-south1; mitigation in progress." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2250012345

CE Support: Sent proactive note to Acme and BetaCorp, included workaround (switch to dedicated capacity or pin to eu-west1).

Infra (Ben Ops): Quota request to cloud provider submitted (case 8675309). Manual provisioning attempted for two spare GPU pools in east2 — some succeeded, some failed due to AZ soft limits. Kicked off manual placement in a different AZ, starting nodes now.

Carla SRE: Re-route to quantized variant holding. p95 now down to ~900ms in eu-west1 for spillover traffic, east2 queue slowly decreasing to 9k. Error rate dropping to ~6.2%.

metrics-bot: east2 queue_depth=9478 p95=1987ms errors=6.2% eu-west1 queue_depth=4200 p95=912ms

Eng Runtime: Started a temporary canary using a smaller model variant (v2-medium) on dedicated reserved capacity for top-tier customers to reduce impact while east2 recovers. Command:```
redwoodctl deploy --region eu-west1 --model v2-medium --capacity reserved:4 --tag=emergency-canary
```

Oncall Anna: Canary deployed, routing top-tier customers (acme-inc) to canary. Early results: acme error rate -> 2%.

Dave Reliability: Handing off to daytime SRE shift in 30m. Leaving mitigation in place. Will prepare incident bridge for postmortem.

Carla SRE: Schedule post-incident eval to look at: autoscaler backoff/retry logic, routing weight rollback safety, and default spillover model selection. Also consider prefilling cold caches for likely spillover regions.

Oncall Anna: Leaving a summary for handoff: "east2 autoscaler hit cloud quota, caused provisioning failures -> queue growth. Routing initially spilled to same model flavor causing cold-start amplification. Mitigations: throttled low-priority, redirected spillover to quantized variants across eu-west1/ap-south1, deployed canary reserved capacity for top customers, requested quota bump and manual provisioning. Customer impact limited to 6 enterprise customers, top-hit acme-inc saw 30% 503s before canary fix. Monitoring & alerts remain. Handing to @Dave Reliability."

Dave Reliability: Taking over. I'll coordinate postmortem and escalate to provider if quota not increased in next 2 hours.

Carla SRE: adding runbook note: change default spillover model to model with cold-start profile <2s and mark v2-large as fallback only if target has warm caches. Runbook snippet:```
# runbook: emergency spillover to quantized variant
rwctl route set-default-spillover --model-filter "quantized:true" --max-weight 60
```

Oncall Anna: Thanks team. Closing paging. Will update status page when fully resolved.

metrics-bot: final snapshot (after manual provision): east2 queue_depth=1200 p95=320ms errors=0.9% eu-west1 queue_depth=800 p95=210ms

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigation applied, monitoring. Postmortem requested: https://docs.redwood.internal/incidents/2250012345/postmortem

Ben Ops: Filing support/infra ticket with cloud provider logs attached.

CE Support: Closing customer-facing tickets with remediation steps and credits offered.

Carla SRE: Marking follow-ups: 1) autoscaler retry/backoff adjustments 2) routing weight safe-guard 3) prefilling KV cache on spillover 4) add synthetic tests for cold-start spillover.

Dave Reliability: Good work. Handing to P0 oncall for watch.

Oncall Anna: logging final note: "Incident mitigated. Leaving temporary throttles and spillover routing until next deploy window. Postmortem scheduled." :white_check_mark:
